clauses.quote: Such payment shall be made on or before October 15 of each school year.
Proof of payment shall be made on an annual basis as a condition of continued exemption from the payment of the service fee.
the District shall deduct the appropriate yearly service fee funds from the unit member and remit those funds to the Association.

The Association agrees to pay to the District all reasonable legal fees and legal costs incurred in defending against any court action and/or administrative action challenging the legality or constitutionality of the agency fee provisions of this agreement or their implementation.

The Association shall have the exclusive right to decide and determine whether any such action or proceeding referred to above shall or shall not be compromised, resisted, defended, tried, or appealed.
One or more members of the District and the Association shall meet on a regular basis during the year for the purpose of maintenance of this agreement.
clauses.subject_text: One or more members of the District and the Association

clauses.quote: In any new teacher orientation program sponsored by the District, the Association shall have the opportunity to make a membership presentation to the assembled new teachers.

Upon the request of the unit member and the professional growth advisor, the president of the Association may provide verification of participation in, or completion of, acceptable Association-related activities.
On any District staff development day, the Association shall have the opportunity, before the general assembly, to make announcements and disseminate information, e.g., have an information table.
Toward this end, site administration shall primarily assist unit members in meeting the California Standards for the Teaching Profession (CSTP).
No later than twenty-five (25) duty days following commencement of duties, the unit member shall submit the Standards (CSTP) for the ensuing year.
Within fifteen (15) duty days following this submission, the unit member and evaluator shall meet and agree on those Standards that shall be applied for evaluative purposes.
The evaluation procedure shall be discussed in this meeting unless previously discussed individually or presented at a staff/faculty meeting.
